description: eSIM NL2SQL 平台评估测试集

items.question: 查询所有 eSIM 套餐的名称和价格
items.gold_sql: SELECT plan_name, price FROM plans

items.question: 列出所有运营商的名称
items.gold_sql: SELECT operator_name FROM operators

items.question: 查询 id 为 1 的用户信息
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1

items.question: 统计总共有多少个 eSIM 套餐
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plans

items.question: 查询所有已激活的用户档案
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM esim_profiles WHERE status = 'active'

items.question: 列出价格大于 50 元的套餐
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE price > 50

items.question: 查询所有处于漫游状态的套餐包
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM roaming_packages WHERE status = 'active'

items.question: 查询每个订单对应的用户名和套餐名
items.gold_sql: SELECT o.id, u.username, p.plan_name FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id

items.question: 查询每个用户的 eSIM 档案状态和用户名
items.gold_sql: SELECT u.username, e.status FROM users u JOIN esim_profiles e ON u.id = e.user_id

items.question: 统计每个套餐的订单数量
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, COUNT(o.id) FROM plans p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.plan_id GROUP BY p.plan_name

items.question: 查询购买了尊享版套餐的用户邮箱
items.gold_sql: SELECT u.email FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN plans p ON o.plan_id = p.id WHERE p.plan_name LIKE '%尊享%'

items.question: 查询每个运营商提供的套餐数量
items.gold_sql: SELECT op.operator_name, COUNT(p.id) FROM operators op LEFT JOIN plans p ON op.id = p.operator_id GROUP BY op.operator_name

items.question: 统计每种订单状态的订单数量
items.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

items.question: 计算所有套餐的平均价格
items.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM plans

items.question: 查询总销售额最高的套餐
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, SUM(o.amount) FROM plans p JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.plan_id GROUP BY p.plan_name ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: 统计各地区的用户数量
items.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY region

items.question: 查询所有订单的总金额
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders

items.question: 统计每个月的订单总数
items.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY month

items.question: 查询平均订单金额
items.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders

items.question: 查询最近 7 天的订单数量
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

items.question: 按天统计上个月的订单量
items.gold_sql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY day

items.question: 查询本月新增的用户数
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')

items.question: 统计过去 30 天各套餐的激活量
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, COUNT(e.id) FROM esim_profiles e JOIN plans p ON e.plan_id = p.id WHERE e.activated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY p.plan_name

items.question: 查询每天的流量使用总量
items.gold_sql: SELECT DATE(record_date) AS day, SUM(data_used_mb) FROM data_usage GROUP BY day

items.question: 查询订单金额最高的前 5 个订单
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: 按销售额对套餐进行排名
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM plans p JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.plan_id GROUP BY p.plan_name ORDER BY total DESC

items.question: 查询流量使用最多的前 10 个用户
items.gold_sql: SELECT user_id, SUM(data_used_mb) AS total FROM data_usage GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: 查询注册用户数最多的地区
items.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM users GROUP BY region ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: 按订单数排名运营商
items.gold_sql: SELECT op.operator_name, COUNT(o.id) FROM operators op JOIN plans p ON op.id = p.operator_id JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.plan_id GROUP BY op.operator_name ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC

items.question: 按套餐分组统计订单金额总和
items.gold_sql: SELECT plan_id, SUM(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY plan_id

items.question: 按状态分组统计档案数量
items.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM esim_profiles GROUP BY status

items.question: 按用户分组统计每个用户的订单数
items.gold_sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY user_id

items.question: 按运营商分组统计套餐平均价格
items.gold_sql: SELECT operator_id, AVG(price) FROM plans GROUP BY operator_id

items.question: 按地区分组统计激活用户数
items.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY region

items.question: 查询价格高于平均价格的套餐
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM plans)

items.question: 查询订单金额大于 100 的订单
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 100

items.question: 查询没有订单的用户
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders)

items.question: 对比基础版和尊享版套餐的价格差异
items.gold_sql: SELECT plan_name, price FROM plans WHERE plan_name LIKE '%基础%' OR plan_name LIKE '%尊享%'

items.question: 查询流量使用超过 1GB 的用户
items.gold_sql: SELECT user_id, SUM(data_used_mb) FROM data_usage GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(data_used_mb) > 1024

items.question: 查询所有用户的用户名和注册地区
items.gold_sql: SELECT username, region FROM users

items.question: 统计套餐表中价格最低的套餐
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM plans ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: 查询最近注册的 10 个用户
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: 统计已激活档案占全部档案的比例
items.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM esim_profiles GROUP BY status

items.question: 查询每个运营商的漫游套餐数量
items.gold_sql: SELECT op.operator_name, COUNT(r.id) FROM operators op JOIN plans p ON op.id = p.operator_id JOIN roaming_packages r ON p.id = r.plan_id GROUP BY op.operator_name

items.question: 查询本月订单金额总和
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')

items.question: 统计各套餐的退款订单数
items.gold_sql: SELECT plan_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded' GROUP BY plan_id

items.question: 查询所有套餐中价格最高的三个
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM plans ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

items.question: 统计本周新增的 eSIM 档案数
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM esim_profiles WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

items.question: 查询每个用户的平均订单金额
items.gold_sql: SELECT user_id, AVG(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY user_id

items.question: 列出所有状态为 pending 的订单
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

items.question: 查询使用流量最多的套餐
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, SUM(d.data_used_mb) FROM plans p JOIN data_usage d ON p.id = d.plan_id GROUP BY p.plan_name ORDER BY SUM(d.data_used_mb) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: 统计不同地区的活跃用户占比
items.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY region

items.question: 查询没有关联档案的用户
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM esim_profiles)

items.question: 按月份统计各套餐销量
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) FROM plans p JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.plan_id GROUP BY p.plan_name, month
